description: Conducted penetration testing on real-world web applications, analyzing authentication mechanisms, authorization, APIs, and business logic, produced professional security reports. Build CTFs challenges for the Openlabs platform.
Engineered secure backend architectures using Node.js and REST APIs. Implemented robust authentication, RBAC, and applied secure coding principles throughout the SDLC.

Reported 30+ valid vulnerabilities across real-world web applications and APIs. Listed in multiple Hall of Fames (ClassDojo, ION Group). Specialized in manual Web Application & API Security Testing following OWASP Top 10 methodologies.
